final.scope: Actual compiled main archive page. Each PNG has model attribution and illustrative timing; ventral details disclose inspection lighting.

changes: Replaced point-filled sucker discs with selected uncapped annular exteriors: folded rim, selected radial relief, central orifice and short throat. Internal sucker tissues remain absent.
Replaced the capped/occluded funnel cue with thin external walls and an exposed ventral outlet. The selected route and dimensions remain unmeasured; no flow or mantle cavity was added.
Added a selected mantle/head aperture boundary and lowered selected ventral bases to clear the funnel region. Tissue unions and the internal cavity remain incomplete.
Added closed thin web margins and removed the invented flat oral cover. Smaller eye cues have corrected lens/pupil depth order; the earlier prototype partly buried the iris.
Added original reproducible fine numerical skin detail and subtle dorsal relief. This is artwork, not organism/SEM pixels or a measured texture map.
Added a disclosed camera-side inspection light for selected octopus ventral anatomy, with contextual ground hidden. Other species and ordinary side/front/top lighting retain their previous setup.

Fit initial instances using their actual posed/scaled cups before normalizing support, then refresh culling bounds through deformation. A rejected prototype floated because unscaled unit-cup bounds were used too early.

Reset capture-time captions when changing actions; a paused Observe view previously retained the preceding action’s caption time. Preserved the same surfaces and existing partial action statuses. No new motion mechanism, species admission or biological certification.
findingsBefore: The point-filled discs hid the central orifice and had no selected annular relief.
The dark underlit cup field and partly hidden closed funnel cue could not be studied clearly.
Flat web cards, a broad invented oral cover and overlapping eye primitives looked artificial.
Body pigment, optics and arm coordination remained numerical and unmeasured.
findingsAfter: Ventral inspection exposes pale rims, annular relief and open selected throats; the repeated cup count/size remains authored.
The external funnel opening is visible, but the short lumen still meets approximate body tissues rather than a reconstructed mantle cavity.
Two-sided web margins and smaller eye cues improve the external illustration; paper-like joins and coarse simplified soft anatomy remain visible at close range.
Same finite support/reach studies work on retained surfaces; full contact, suction, jetting and physiology remain unfinished.
limitations: The model remains an unmeasured, partly stylized adult external study. Arm lengths, the still rather radial/straight spread, narrow distal tapers and basal unions, mantle/head shape, papillae, eye anatomy, skin diversity/optics and true self-collision/contact remain incomplete. The selected neck aperture, short collar and tissue intersections remain approximate; portions of unmodelled anatomy can be visible through the short funnel lumen. The selected 38 sucker pairs per arm, local relief and dimensions are authored choices, not specimen measurements. Fine circumferential grooves remain incomplete. Suckers show an external annulus and short orifice/throat, without a reconstructed internal acetabulum, protuberance, cuticular denticles/hairs, sealing or pressure mechanics. The external funnel has an open lip and short illustrative lumen, but no continuous mantle cavity, valve, pumping or fluid solver. Oral/beak anatomy is absent; the invented flat oral cover was removed. Existing finite arm extension/support and exploratory reach remain partial; food handling, complete crawling and jet escape are unfinished. Underside inspection lighting improves visibility and hides the contextual ground; it is not calibrated natural illumination. No 90-percent accuracy, physiological simulation, independent expert review or biological validation is claimed.

draftHistory: Earlier private candidates retained underlit sucker faces, hid the funnel, partly buried the iris, and briefly floated after unit instanced bounds contaminated the normalization. These were rejected/corrected after actual screenshots. Later compiled frames exposed blocky mantle loft sections and a dorsal seam; those frame sets were rejected, the lofts were smoothed and the selected dorsal tissue bridge broadened before final recapture. The oral cover and zero-thickness web margins were also revised. A later reference comparison rejected a funnel route over anterior arm tissues; the candidate neck aperture, short collar and selected ventral base heights were revised, but their unions/internal continuity remain incomplete. No rejected draft is counted among final compiled views.
